notes.title: 2024年8月9日更新
notes.content:
修正0190号成就无法激活的BUG。
Fixed the bug where achievement 0190 cannot be activated.

notes.title: 2024年4月21日更新
notes.content:
[h1][b]感谢玩家琉璃碎提出的成就错位BUG 已修复[/b][/h1]

近期应玩家要求又增加了一些成就

首几曾候楼阙慵归艾亚建设
挨哎唉哀按岸昂爸班般板版拌伴办浅查
朵母阖令脉鼓旅途坦诡计将瓦重

完整清单请查看此链接，CTRL+F可开启搜索功能。
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2951817732

notes.title: 更新2023年3月16日
notes.content:
2023年3月16日更新
修复了玲儿题库用尽不循环的BUG。
固定了一些NPC位置，防止堵路。
答题开始前会询问是否要开始了。
左右的机器上增加了查询当前答对数量和兑换成就的功能。（以后如果追加新成就老玩家可以方便在这个机器上直接领取，避免需要重新答题一轮才结算。）
成就增加20个，现在汉字成就一共100个了。题库量目前共200。
汉字成就预留上限提高到了300。

Updated on March 16, 2023
Fixed the bug that Linger's question bank ran out of cycles.
Fixed some NPC positions to prevent blocking.
Before answering questions, we will ask if we want to start.
The function of querying the current number of correct answers and redeeming achievements has been added to the left and right machines. (In the future, if new achievements are added, old players can easily claim them directly on this machine, avoiding the need to answer questions again before settlement.)
Achievements increased by 20, and now there are 100 achievements in Chinese characters. The number of question banks is currently 200.
The Chinese character achievement reservation limit has been raised to 300.

2023年3月13日更新
增加了玲儿题库到100题，至此菲儿和玲儿题库已各100。
增加了幕后花絮。
增加了语音预览区。
增加了多位NPC，包括多名制作组成员，和一些彩蛋角色。
替换了多个角色的头像，对白。
恢复了一部分NPC自由移动。
更换了玲儿行走图。

如有任何修改优化问题，可以留言或者邮件u_uju@163.com

PS：这款游戏即便没有多国语言翻译，也可以轻松得到全部成就。

The Linger question bank has been increased to 100 questions, so far Feier and Linger question banks have been 100 each.
Added behind-the-scenes details.
Added voice preview area.
A number of NPCs have been added, including many production team members and some colored egg characters.
Replaced the avatars and dialogues of multiple characters.
Some NPC free movement has been restored.
Replaced Linger's walking chart.
If you have any modification and optimization problems, you can leave a message or email u_uju@163.com
PS: This game can easily achieve all the achievements even without translation in many languages.

送给新老粉丝OST DLC（进Q群52756441私聊可以私发，但请尽快激活，未来几个星期可能注销未使用KEY。）

notes.content:
增加了玲儿题库到100题，至此菲儿和玲儿题库已各100。
增加了幕后花絮。
增加了语音预览区。
增加了多位NPC，包括多名制作组成员，和一些彩蛋角色。
替换了多个角色的头像，对白。
恢复了一部分NPC自由移动。
更换了玲儿行走图。

如有任何修改优化问题，可以留言或者邮件u_uju@163.com

PS：这款游戏即便没有多国语言翻译，也可以轻松得到全部成就。

The Linger question bank has been increased to 100 questions, so far Feier and Linger question banks have been 100 each.
Added behind-the-scenes details.
Added voice preview area.
A number of NPCs have been added, including many production team members and some colored egg characters.
Replaced the avatars and dialogues of multiple characters.
Some NPC free movement has been restored.
Replaced Linger's walking chart.
If you have any modification and optimization problems, you can leave a message or email u_uju@163.com
PS: This game can easily achieve all the achievements even without translation in many languages.
